def norm_shape(cs):
    rs=[p[0] for p in cs]; cc=[p[1] for p in cs]
    mr,mc=min(rs),min(cc)
    pts=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cs]
    h=max(p[0]for p in pts)+1; w=max(p[1]for p in pts)+1
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=1
    def keys(g):
        ks=[]; cur=g[:]
        for _ in range(4):
            for f in [lambda a:a, lambda a:[r[::-1] for r in a]]:
                ks.append(tuple(tuple(x) for x in f(cur)))
            cur=[list(x) for x in zip(*cur)][::-1]
        return tuple(sorted(set(ks)))
    return keys(g)

def comps(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if seen[a][b]: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==col:
                            stack.append((na,nb))
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs2=[p[1] for p in cells]
                key=tuple(sorted(cells))
                out.append((key,col,len(cells),min(rs),min(cs2)))
    return out

                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if seen[a][b]: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
